# Fetch all pages of the Spotify song library

spotify_token = spotify_token  # from previous step

all_library_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_library_songs', len(all_library_songs))
print('first_song', all_library_songs[0]['song_id'], all_library_songs[0]['title'])
print('last_song', all_library_songs[-1]['song_id'], all_library_songs[-1]['title'])

arguments.code:
# Determine least-played song in the Spotify song library by using play_count from show_song

library_songs = all_library_songs

song_play_counts = []
for s in library_songs:
    song_id = s['song_id']
    detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    # detail includes title and play_count per API schema
    song_play_counts.append({
        'song_id': song_id,
        'title': detail.get('title') or s.get('title'),
        'play_count': detail.get('play_count')
    })

# Print verification artifact
print('song_play_counts_count', len(song_play_counts))
print('sample_play_counts', song_play_counts[:5])

# Find minimum play_count
min_play = min(x['play_count'] for x in song_play_counts)
least = [x for x in song_play_counts if x['play_count'] == min_play]
print('min_play', min_play)
print('least_count', len(least))
print('least_candidates', sorted(least, key=lambda x: (x['title'] or '')))

# Deterministic tie-break: alphabetical title
least_sorted = sorted(least, key=lambda x: (x['title'] or ''))
least_title = least_sorted[0]['title']
print('least_title', least_title)
